cards.answer: Vladimir is a mage/fighter who deals magic damage and heals himself through his spells. His fighting pattern combines empowered drains, charged area damage and temporary untargetability; AP and health support his kit.
cards.counterplay: Back away during his empowered drain window, spread out against his area spells, and pressure him after his pool ends.

cards.answer: Transfusion deals magic damage to a target enemy and heals Vladimir. Building Crimson Rush triggers a brief surge with bonus movement speed; casting Transfusion during it deals increased damage and adds healing based on his missing health.
cards.counterplay: Keep your distance during his surge and look to trade after the empowered window passes.

cards.answer: Sanguine Pool costs health and briefly makes Vladimir untargetable while he can still move. Enemies in the pool are slowed and take magic damage, healing Vladimir for part of the damage dealt. He cannot attack or cast abilities during it, but can release an already charging Tides of Blood.
cards.counterplay: Move out of the pool, save targeted attacks for its end, and respect a charged Tides of Blood.

cards.answer: Tides of Blood charges at a health cost, then releases blood bolts around Vladimir that deal magic damage to the first enemy hit. Charging increases the damage, and a sufficiently charged release also briefly slows enemies hit.
cards.counterplay: Create distance while he charges or use intervening units to intercept the bolts.

cards.answer: Hemoplague infects enemies in a targeted area, temporarily increasing the damage they take. When the infection ends, it deals magic damage and heals Vladimir for each infected champion, with reduced healing from additional champions.
cards.counterplay: Spread out before he casts and avoid committing to a fight while infected.
